title: Three divergent states: main branch, hosted service, and unmerged branch
evidence: main HEAD fa0d4e3 (2026-08-30) README/MODEL_CARD/CODEX describe a live 16-endpoint scoring demo; hosted /health returns product_mode=research_prototype, scoring_enabled=false and /players/search returns 503, matching api/main.py on origin/codex/engine-v2-safety-freeze (8 commits, +30,215/-214 lines, not merged); that branch holds docs/ENGINE_V1_FREEZE.md, ENGINE_V2_CRITICAL_ISSUES.md and all Engine V2 code; working tree on main contains untracked engine_v2_* output directories without their source.
files: README.md; docs/MODEL_CARD.md; CODEX.md; api/main.py; html/index.html; scripts/railway_bootstrap.py; origin/codex/engine-v2-safety-freeze; git_and_deployment_state.json
consequence: A reader of the public default branch is told the tool is live and validated; the service actually refuses to score, and the validity findings that caused the freeze are invisible on main.
classification: invalidates main's product-status claims; constrains everything else
repair: Merge or rebase the branch into main via a reviewed PR (or, at minimum, update README, MODEL_CARD and CODEX on main to the frozen/paused status); record which commit Railway deploys; remove or commit the leftover engine_v2_* outputs.

title: User-proposed wage and term are predictors inside 12 of 16 V1 artifacts, so sporting and public-value probabilities move with the proposal
evidence: deployed_artifact_feature_inventory.csv: all Phase 1-3 artifacts (incl. C6) use exact_duration_years, age_at_expiration, log_annual_gross_eur, log_fixed_wage_commitment_eur, salary_change_from_prior_pct, annual_wage_to_market_value, commitment_to_market_value, club_salary_percentile/share. T1 grid (10 real 2023 profiles, live retriever+scorer): proposed term 2->6 years moves mean sustained-contribution 0.526->0.706, stay-24m 0.450->0.752, downside-25% 0.536->0.373; wage x3 moves sustained 0.575->0.683 and downside-50% 0.284->0.153. Training semantics = realized signed terms; cohort sustained rate rises from 0.37 (2-3y) to 0.69 (5y+) and from 0.25 to 0.72 across signed-wage quintiles.
consequence: The displayed contribution, continuity and value-downside probabilities partly restate the club's own proposal (a selection effect from historical deals), not decision-time-valid player risk; a user can raise every favourable number by proposing a bigger, longer contract. The V2 branch reached the same conclusion and excluded these fields.
classification: invalidates the live interpretation of the V1 sporting and value endpoints; historical association remains reportable with the caveat
repair: Refit sporting/value endpoints without commercial-scenario fields (branch Phase 2 shows compact 6-field candidates retain AUC ~0.75/0.82); keep proposal inputs only in deterministic and peer-benchmark cards; re-run parity and OOS checks.

title: Out-of-sample verifier includes immature survival rows only when the event already happened
evidence: scripts/verify_deployment_out_of_sample.py filters on {ep}_horizon_observable_{h} = event OR followup>=horizon. oos_verifier_maturity_bias.csv: any_outbound_36m cohort n=196 has 0 rows with 1,095 days of follow-up (event rate 1.000; reported Brier 0.094 is on an all-positive sample); any_outbound_24m includes 79 of 323 rows only because an event occurred (event rate 0.604 vs 0.475 on fully followed rows); permanent_outbound_24m 47 of 291. Verifier still reports 29/29 passed.
consequence: The published post-2023 survival numbers are biased and the 36m figure is meaningless; corrected (full follow-up only) any_outbound_24m AUC 0.689 (n=243), permanent_outbound_24m AUC 0.697 (n=243), 36m: no valid rows.
classification: constrains scope (survival OOS claims); verifier defect
repair: Require administrative_followup_days >= horizon for every OOS survival row; drop the 36m OOS row until 2027; re-run and re-publish.

title: 'Low contribution' and the euro exposure proxy conflate departures with low use
evidence: cohort_target_and_overlap_audit.json: of 691 non-sustainers in the 1,385 primary cohort, 433 had any outbound within 730 days (238 permanent); only 258 stayed and were under-used. Of the €1.82B 'attached to low contribution' in the 908-profile illustration, €0.77B (42%) belongs to players permanently transferred within 24 months and €1.17B (64%) to any outbound. Interface label: 'modeled low-contribution wage exposure over 24 months'.
consequence: The headline euro card counts wages a club stops paying after a sale (and may receive a fee for) as exposure; the probability blends injury/form decline, loans and sales into one number.
repair: Decompose the target as the V2 branch does (Meaningful Retention vs Temporary Displacement vs Permanent Separation); cap exposure at the departure date; relabel the card.

title: Globally specified goals/assists-per-90 remain in 11 of 16 V1 artifacts and produce counterintuitive live explanations
evidence: deployed_artifact_feature_inventory.csv (uses_global_scoring_rates=True for 11 artifacts incl. contract_duration); role_contextualization_diagnostic: sign-stable positive hazard coefficients on goals-per-90; t3_present_day_demo_profiles.json: for Haaland and Mbappe the continuity explanation lists 'Goals per 90 (last 365 days)' and 'Goals per 90 (2 seasons ago)' as raising departure risk. Only C6 (sustained contribution) was repaired.
consequence: Face-invalid explanations on main's interface; a global linear coefficient on heavy-tailed per-90 rates is not football-defensible across positions.
repair: Remove scoring-rate features (branch Phase 2 removed them); do not add role interactions unless they clear a pre-declared gate (the role diagnostic already found them mixed).

title: Continuity endpoints are weak in Ligue 1 and mutually inconsistent
evidence: Reconstructed V1 M5: any_outbound_24m Ligue 1 AUC 0.609 (skill +0.012), 36m 0.584, permanent 0.585; V2 repaired candidate Ligue 1 skill -0.0066 (reproduced); direct classifier beat the deployed survival formulation (AUC 0.714 vs 0.703). permanent>=stay clamp applied in 49/547 OOS profiles and 23/58 of the project's own live sample.
consequence: main's Contract-Horizon Stability card shows a personalised probability for Ligue 1 players with near-chance ranking; the two survival models disagree on a logically ordered pair for a material share of profiles.
repair: Retire or subgroup-gate (branch retired it); if kept, fit the ordered pair jointly.

title: Phase-4 '80% historical reference range' is a marginal, single-width interval with 66-71% coverage in identifiable subgroups
evidence: metric_reconstruction.csv: fixed_wage_commitment coverage 0.801 pooled but 0.661 when prior wage unknown (504 of 1,504 rows) and 0.701 for <EUR1m players; annual_wage Ligue 1 0.71; V2 sealed 2024 test: pooled 0.770, Ligue 1 0.594-0.606, Bundesliga 0.696, prior-wage-unknown 0.684.
consequence: The card tells every user the range is an '80% reference range'; for a third of players and for Ligue 1 it is closer to a two-thirds range.
repair: Condition interval width on prior-wage availability/league (or quantile regression); display support status per profile.

title: Outputs are conditional on an extension having been signed; main does not say so
evidence: Cohort = 2,805 Capology extension events; no un-extended comparison population. Branch docs/ENGINE_V2_VALIDITY_BOUNDARY.md states the limitation; README.md and docs/MODEL_CARD.md on main do not.
consequence: Probabilities cannot support 'should we extend' or counterfactual comparisons; they describe outcomes among players clubs chose to extend on the terms they chose.
repair: State the conditioning in MODEL_CARD/README and interface copy.

title: Rolling-origin evaluation is not player-disjoint
evidence: 13-37% of evaluation-year events belong to players already present in earlier years (cohort_target_and_overlap_audit.json). Seen-vs-unseen split of the frozen predictions: Phase 1 AUC 0.793 vs 0.787, Phase 2 0.703 vs 0.703, Phase 3 0.840 vs 0.808, Phase 4 commitment MAE 0.576 vs 0.725 and coverage 0.872 vs 0.777. Branch Phase 5 found 2024 role/continuity labels were exposed in aggregate.
consequence: Pooled metrics are mildly optimistic for first-time extensions; the wage benchmark's headline coverage is materially better for repeat players than for new ones.
repair: Report player-disjoint metrics alongside pooled; reserve a later untouched, player-disjoint cohort for any promotion.
repair_possible: partially now; fully with later data

title: Calibration drift on the newest cohort
evidence: t2 live re-score, signed 2024-25: sustained contribution mean prediction 0.526 vs observed 0.475, ECE 0.094 (n=80); downside 24m ECE 0.13-0.15 (n=41); downside 12m ECE 0.045 (n=381) is fine.
consequence: Small samples, but the direction (over-optimism on contribution) matches the frozen ECE 0.046 and the C6 selection note.
repair: Re-assess when the 2024-25 cohort matures; apply validation-only recalibration.

title: Live inputs are stale or absent relative to training semantics
evidence: t3: sporting data ends 2026-07-06 (65 days before today); demo market values dated 2025-06-08 to 2025-12-12 (271-458 days old); advanced FBref features unavailable for all three demo players; OOS re-score imputes 5.1 features per downside score on average. A caller-supplied stale market value bypasses the retriever's >365-day warning (only the input field shows age).
consequence: Missing-indicator columns fire for reasons different from training; recent involvement is undercounted; vintage is only partially visible.
repair: Refresh cadence with visible vintage; propagate market-value staleness into profile warnings; treat systematically-missing live blocks as unsupported rather than imputed.

title: Arbitrary player-club pairings are scored with a warning on main's API
evidence: t3 probe: Bellingham scored against club 985 (Manchester United) returns status=scored, incumbency_verified=false with a warning only; the HTML hides club choice but the API does not refuse. Branch V2 validity boundary makes this a hard refusal.
consequence: Documented misuse path (acquisition scoring) is reachable by any API client.
repair: Hard-refuse unverified incumbency unless a dated roster/contract evidence flag is supplied.

title: The 2020-2023 evaluation years have been reused for every selection decision; no untouched V1 holdout remains
evidence: Phase 1-5 decisions, business audit, C6 selection among 6 candidates, role diagnostic (4 candidates x 13 endpoints), refinement experiment and branch Phases 2-4 all select on the same four evaluation years; the only later cohort (2024) is immature and partially exposed.
consequence: Reported pooled metrics carry selection optimism of unknown size; the branch correctly refuses to open 2024 for the predictive modules.
repair: Freeze candidates and wait for a mature player-disjoint cohort (2025-26 signings mature in 2028).

title: Display-time corrections are load-bearing and hide model incoherence
evidence: PAVA re-ordering applied to 16/547 OOS profiles and 12/300 perturbation cells; permanent>=stay clamp applied to 49/547 OOS and 40% of the project's live sample; business_metric_engine raises ValueError (HTTP 422) without them.
consequence: Independently fitted threshold/horizon models are not mutually coherent; corrections are documented but users see corrected numbers with a footnote at most.
repair: Fit ordered thresholds jointly (ordinal/cumulative models) and the any/permanent pair jointly.

title: Deployment used the maximal M5 feature set uniformly, not the minimal validated one
evidence: Phase 1 M3-vs-M2 improvement -0.0021 (CI includes 0); Phase 3 contract economics at 24m 'add signal: False'; yet every Phase 1-3 artifact except C6 carries all 27 features (51% missing pre2, 31% missing FBref in cohort).
consequence: Dependence on missing-indicator columns and unstable blocks with no validated benefit.
repair: Deploy the smallest feature set that passed each endpoint's gate.

title: C6 was promoted on a non-inferiority route after selecting among six candidates on the reporting folds
evidence: contribution_model_repair/model_selection_decision.csv: C6 vs C0 +0.0022 Brier, 95% CI [-0.0009, +0.0053], 2/4 origin wins; manifest documents this honestly.
consequence: C6 is not an improvement claim; it is a face-validity repair with unchanged accuracy, and it still carries the proposal-term features (MM-02).
repair: Describe C6 as a specification repair; fold into the MM-02 refit.

title: Verifier independence and reproducibility limits
evidence: Every verify_* script imports the runner's load_frame/FEATURE_SETS, so target-construction errors would pass both; verify_deployment_models.py and verify_live_request_integrity.py write into the frozen artifact directory (a rerun changes freeze-hashed files); live_request_integrity uses today's date.
consequence: 'Independent verification' checks arithmetic and hashes, not target semantics; freeze and verification are coupled.
repair: Write verification outputs elsewhere; add a target-construction spot check from raw tables; pin decision dates.

title: Data-quality residues in the modeling master
evidence: 79 events with missing position and 1 non-canonical label ('Midfield - Central Midfield'); at-signing valuation gap up to 5,724 days permitted in Phase 1/2/4 cohorts (strict 365-day rule only in Phase 3); 97.2% player linkage; Premier League 2022-23 extension page absent; 65 first outbound events typed loan_return.
consequence: Small but unhandled edge cases; the branch surfaced the malformed label only after opening its holdout.
repair: Normalise labels; enforce the 365-day valuation rule in every phase; document the missing PL 2022-23 page as a cohort gap.

title: Dormant or superseded assets that could be mistaken for live results
evidence: Untracked engine_v2_* prediction CSVs in the working tree without their source; Data/app-html/index.html (superseded UI); html/MOVE MAKER - Extension Profile v2.dc.html; git/ (53MB copy of repo metadata); .tmp (296MB); outputs/ (253MB legacy compatibility workbooks); model_dataset*.csv legacy matrices; README screenshot showing the retired continuity card; slides with figures (EUR 21.99B, 1,135 exits) derived from local data only.
files: Data/processed/engine_v2_*; Data/app-html; html/*.dc.html; git/; .tmp; outputs/; Data/processed/model_dataset*.csv; docs/assets/movemaker-live-profile.png
consequence: Confusing provenance; risk of citing research outputs as product outputs.
repair: Commit branch outputs with their source or remove them; delete git/ copy; move legacy matrices under an archive path.

title: Documentation gaps on main
evidence: CODEX.md and CLAUDE.md are gitignored (the 'authoritative handoff' is not in the repository); DATA_PROVENANCE.md omits StatsBomb; MODEL_CARD lacks the selection-conditioning and proposal-input caveats; README calls the hosted site a 'live demo'.
consequence: Reviewers cannot see the operating rules or the current status from the public tree.
repair: Commit the handoff; update provenance and model card.

title: API hardening and environment drift
evidence: CORS allow_origins=['*']; no authentication or rate limiting; decision_date = server date (non-reproducible profiles); local FastAPI 0.138.1 vs pinned 0.116.1.
consequence: Acceptable for a paused research site; not for a scoring service.
repair: Tighten CORS, add a decision_date parameter, pin and test the environment.

title: Engine V2 has no authorised output; its own gates blocked every candidate
evidence: Branch: continuity retired (Ligue 1 negative skill reproduced), wage benchmark failed the sealed Ligue 1 coverage gate (reproduced: 0.594-0.606; Bundesliga 0.696 in this reconstruction), 2024 role/continuity labels exposed, value-downside holdout n=26 underpowered. Meaningful Retention (AUC 0.759) and Temporary Displacement (0.777) reproduce as development candidates only.
consequence: Nothing beyond frozen V1 evidence and deterministic arithmetic is currently promotable.
repair: Wait for a mature player-disjoint cohort; declare successors as new versions.

title: 'Any outbound' first-event semantics include loan returns from the extension club
evidence: first_any_outbound_type counts: transfer 1,289, loan 592, loan_return 65 (of 2,805). A loan return recorded as leaving the extension club implies the player's spell there was itself a loan, or a data-typing artefact.
consequence: Small share, but the continuity target may count non-employer relationships.
repair: Review the 65 cases against canonical transfer records.
